## Biography

CMDR Nor found the beacon. That is what matters.

During the search for the missing Universal Cartographics cruiser Guinevere, while the fleet swept wide cones and waited for signals that never came, Nor located a damaged DSSA beacon broadcasting a dead man's voice. The recording was old. The trajectory, once Lya back-traced it, pointed toward permit-locked systems in the Praei2 sector — coordinates nobody should have been exploring. Nor did not make speeches about the discovery. Logged it, dumped the raw data, and waited for the science team to catch up. That is how independent pilots have always worked: find the thread, pull it, hand it to someone who knows what the knot means.
